tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: List every league/data group this API serves (nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, pga, dfs, reference) with table counts and availability. No credentials needed. Start here, then call list_tables.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List every queryable table in one league with a one-line summary each. No credentials needed. Follow with describe_table before querying.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Full contract for one table: fields with types and descriptions, the filters query_table accepts (with operators like __gte/__lte/__between/__like and required filter combinations), page-size limits, primary key, and a runnable example URL. No credentials needed. Always call this before query_table

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Query any table. Returns `{"<table>": [rows], "limit": N, "next_from_id": M|null, "has_more": bool}`. To read every row, start with from_id=0 and re-call with from_id set to the previous next_from_id until it is null. A call without from_id returns the first page in the table's default sort with nex

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Fetch a single row by primary key. Returns the row object. Requires a stat-api sign-in or API key; costs 1 record of quota.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Fuzzy player-name search (typo-tolerant). Currently NBA only — for other leagues query the players table with a name filter via query_table. Returns player rows ordered by match quality. Requires a stat-api sign-in or API key; rows count against quota.

tools.name: games_on_date
tools.description: Games scheduled/played on one calendar date (US-Eastern) for nba, mlb, or nhl; defaults to today. Returns the same envelope as query_table on the games table. NFL is week-based, not date-based — for nfl, use query_table on nfl/games with season_id + week filters instead. Requires a stat-api sign-in

tools.name: api_usage
tools.description: Your account's quota position: plan, monthly record limit, records used, remaining, and when the quota resets. Requires a stat-api sign-in or API key; costs 1 record.
